answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The velvet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
